categories.main_business_segments: OBIC operates primarily in three business segments: System Integration (development and sales of integrated enterprise systems), System Support (operation support and maintenance services for enterprise systems), and Office Automation (sales of OA equipment and computer supplies). Additionally, business application package software is provided through an equity-method affiliate, OBIC Business Consultant, but is not included in the consolidated segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: OBIC's core technologies center on the development of integrated ERP software, notably the OBIC7 Series, which consolidates accounting and business management functions. The company emphasizes proprietary system development, cloud computing infrastructure, and robust information security management, including compliance with international standards such as SSAE18 SOC1/SOC2. Production methods include in-house software development, customization for industry-specific needs, and operation of private cloud data centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: OBIC primarily serves large and mid-sized enterprises across a wide range of industries, including manufacturing, distribution, services, and finance. Its solutions are tailored for companies seeking to improve productivity and operational efficiency through advanced information systems, with a focus on direct sales to corporate clients rather than retail or consumer markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with major offices and data centers in Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, and other key Japanese cities. OBIC does not report significant overseas sales or assets, and its customer base is almost exclusively domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: OBIC operates downstream in the IT services supply chain, directly providing end-to-end solutions, including system development, implementation, and ongoing support, to enterprise customers. It does not manufacture hardware but integrates and supports third-party equipment as part of its solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, OBIC focuses on continuous innovation in ERP and cloud services, enhancing customization and integration capabilities (especially with the OBIC7 Series), and leveraging AI and digital technologies for data utilization. R&D priorities include expanding cloud offerings, strengthening information security, and adapting to regulatory changes such as IFRS. The company also invests in human capital development and business continuity planning.
categories.revenue_model: OBIC generates revenue primarily through direct sales of enterprise software and systems, recurring fees for cloud-based services and system support, and sales of office automation equipment. Maintenance, operation support, and consulting services provide stable, ongoing revenue streams, while hardware and package software sales are more transactional.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OBIC is positioned as a leading ERP and IT solutions provider in Japan, competing with domestic system integrators such as Otsuka Corporation, NS Solutions, and NTT Data, as well as global ERP vendors like SAP and Oracle in the Japanese market. The company is recognized for its high profitability and direct sales approach, maintaining a top-tier industry position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, OBIC reported consolidated net sales of 121.2 billion yen (approx. $800 million), operating profit of 78.4 billion yen, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 64.6 billion yen, with a workforce of 2,189 employees. The company has demonstrated consistent revenue and profit growth (8-11% YoY), high operating margins (over 60%), and maintains a strong balance sheet with an equity ratio above 85%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OBIC differentiates itself through its fully integrated, customizable ERP solutions (OBIC7 Series), direct sales and support model, and proprietary cloud infrastructure, enabling rapid deployment and high customer satisfaction. The company emphasizes reliability, security, and the ability to provide one-stop, end-to-end solutions tailored to diverse industry needs, supported by deep domain expertise and ongoing innovation.
